story.p: Priya and Rohan met at a cousin's sangeet, where both had been volunteered for the same dance and neither knew the steps. They spent the evening laughing at their own mistakes.
Rehearsals turned into long phone calls, then Sunday coffees across the city. He learned how she takes her chai. She learned that he hums old film songs when he's nervous.
When their parents finally met over lunch, the conversation ran four hours and ended with both mothers swapping recipes. The dates were set before dessert.
